$comment: Implements spec 03 §7 (progression and promotion: automatic, stage_transition, threshold, class_council, graduation; the compute -> review -> approve -> commit workflow of spec 04 §6). This file is the schema for progression.json.
title: Curriculum pack progression rules (progression.json)
description: Declarative promotion and graduation rules evaluated by the year-end promotion run (spec 03 §7).

progression.description: Promotion rules by level. Each level appears in at most one rule (runtime check).

graduation.description: Levels that end the programme and graduate the learner (spec 03 §7). Optional for a pack that stops before a terminal year.

rule.description: Promotion method from spec 03 §7 (C-9): automatic, stage_transition, threshold or class_council.

to_stage.description: Stage the learner enters after this level, for example SS after G9 (spec 03 §7).

requires.description: Records that must exist before the transition, for example the KJSEA result and a pathway placement (spec 03 §7, Appendix A).

conditions.description: Threshold conditions that must all hold, for example annual average and English and Mathematics at 40 or above (spec 03 §7).

else.description: Decision when a threshold condition fails: repeat, or refer the case to the class council (spec 03 §7). The promotion run records the outcome as a promotion_decision (spec 02 §7).

suggest.description: The metric the engine uses to suggest a decision, while the class council decides, for example annual.moyenne at 10 or above (spec 03 §7).

levels.description: Terminal levels at which a learner graduates (spec 03 §7 example: G12, F4, Y13, SS3, Terminale).

rule.description: The only graduation action named in spec 03 §7.

metric.description: A computed result path, for example annual.average, annual.ENG or annual.moyenne (spec 03 §7). The first segment names the period scope, the rest a result field or learning-area code.

gte.description: Minimum value the metric must reach (spec 03 §7 examples: 40, 10).
